bullets.content: [general] Copying the leader's mesh earns no hidden-point or diversity bonus. Change h by >1.5x or change the refinement targets on purpose.

[general] A nested box or edge only bites at <=0.7x the local h it sits in. Read hotspot local h, request 0.7x, and check 'element size near' after mesh(). Failures: 0.0026 in 0.0035, 0.0035 junction, 0.0036 in 0.0041.
[general] On thin-walled 3D parts, P2 DOFs grew ~h^-1.3 and error fell only ~N^-0.4 (estimate). Uniform shrinking is a poor buy; grade locally with a box around the hotspot band.

[general] Use all 4 solves: s1 control, s2 one-factor fix of top hotspot, s3 one-factor cost probe, s4 best combination. Include at least one clearly cheaper structural variant (>15% fewer DOFs), not near-identical radius/size probes. List differences before each mesh().

[general] solve() uses the LAST mesh() call. Immediately before every solve, re-issue the intended mesh() and check the node count in the solve reply matches. Past wasted solves (g5 solve 1, a6, a10) came from this.
[general] Right after solve 1 call view(kind=error) and write the top-5 hotspots with local h (skipped in g4 and g5); compare each with the requested size before the second mesh().
[general] Never call compare(n,n) (repeated mistake). Write the two distinct solve numbers first; compare(baseline, variant) once per experiment.
[general] Spend solves on single-factor tests with predicted DOF change >5%; skip smaller probes (equal-DOF box swaps wasted a solve). Compute node change from mesh() first.
[general] Do not re-solve a recipe whose energy you know (meshing is deterministic). Spend that solve on a x0.75 reference so compare() gives an error estimate.

[general] Before solving, print the request and check it against your plan. A past promise of 'no whole large faces' was broken by refining f5, f7, f9 groups. Verify every refinement against stated constraints.

[general] Meshing is deterministic: peers reproduce meshes from playbook notes. After every mesh(), compare nodes with known counts (a14 6684, a12/a2 6765, 6315, 5638, 5997). If within 1.5%, change a target or size by >=10% before solving: ties pay nobody.

[general] After every solve read top-5 hotspots (face, local h) and view(kind=error, iso). Before submitting call compare(coarsest, finest) and read its top regions: where the field moves outside your boxes is the next refinement.

[general] Never take the one-factor tweak the playbook literally names (e.g. 'flank zmin 0.020'): a2 and a12 both did, got identical 6765-node meshes, zero bonuses. Pick a factor the playbook does not spell out.

[general] Pick submission by estimated score (g/2)^2/c per solve, e estimated from compare vs the finest. Run a cheaper sibling by changing ONE refinement only. Never scale several sizes at once (x1.25 all-sizes was unattributable).
[general] Submit by evidence: with similar DOFs the higher strain energy wins (g5: 2.13399e-4 J at 16749 beat submitted 2.13287e-4 at 16809). Don't override with 'fewer hotspots' impressions.
[general] Score ~ (g/2)^2/(DOFs/6057). At 20k DOFs, g 1.81 gave 0.242; g 1.8 at 14k would give ~0.35, so cutting DOFs matters more than shaving error.
[general] Rank by field error x DOFs: 8.38x16.8k=141k vs control 142k, equal. A structural diversity bonus needs a clearly different h or refinement targets; a small box swap is not enough.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Explorer fallbacks: if >7200 nodes raise wall boxes to 0.0034 first, not points; if min_quality<0.12 raise point radii to 0.006. Keep body 0.0054 (0.0058 reads ~11% low in lower wall). Front/back wall cells (±0.0058,±0.0129,z0.0255) hold ~12% error at h 0.0044-0.0047; check size near f20.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Solve plan: s1 explorer recipe; s2 same without the 8 points; s3 best of s1/s2 with wall boxes zmin 0.016 or size 0.0034 (one factor). Known baseline 0.033445 J at 20295 DOFs. Pays if energy>=0.03345 at <=20.3k DOFs.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Rank by e²·DOFs (~0.1% energy ≈ 1% field). Energy->field: 0.03316->18.7-18.9%, 0.03335->18.1%, 0.03342->17.7%, 0.03362->17.2%. Bar 623 (g3 recipe); 17.9%² x 20.3k=650 loses, so submit cheaper known recipe unless a variant beats it. Unique recipe at >=90% of best base beats tuned copy.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Flank size lever is flat: 0.0034 ->6211 nodes, 0.033236 J (e²N~745); 0.003 ->6765, 0.033445 (650); 0.0026 ->7642, 0.033535 (~662). Never spend solves on flank size. Body 0.0048 (+2640 DOFs) not worth it. Try structural change, e.g. h 0.016 with junction and f2 boxes (~14k DOFs).

[abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle hotspots near f12/f9/f13 (|x|~0.014,|y|~0.009,z 0.020-0.022, 8.5% error) sit in 0.0035 boxes yet h 0.0040-0.0042; boxes give ~1.15x requested size. Point refinements 0.0027 r0.005 there are the explorer test.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring (four z 0.0561 cells, ~14%) is saturated: f2 0.0025 + edge 40 0.0025 is the floor. Extra clamp box 0.0034 cost +7.6% nodes; past clamp boxes +0.2% energy for +11%. Leave it. Self idea: f2 0.003 r0.004 to save DOFs.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Edge 40 below 0.0025 does nothing (0.0022 r0.006: 0.033321 vs 0.033445 J, quality 0.12; a1 0.002 same). Keep edge 40 at 0.0025 r0.004 or drop it.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a1: dropping edges 39/8 from g3 gave 17.7k DOFs, energy 0.03319 vs 0.03335 at 18.9k. Highlight a0 (base 0.246, best): body 0.0054, f2/edge40 0.0025, edges 39/8 0.0024 r0.004, flanks [±0.010..0.023,|y|<=0.014,z0.021-0.034] 0.0036 r0.005, 20.1k DOFs, 17.7%: wide coarser flanks beat narrow 0.003.

[abc_00000003_bc7] f20 has ~2656 elements at h 0.0044; don't refine group. Worst hidden points: near f20 (0.017,-0.004,0.0255) 26% (P3 gave -9.8%) and near f23 bore bottom (0.017,0.013,0.005). Test small box size 0.003 e.g. [0.01,0.005,0,0.024,0.018,0.012] or around saddle (-0.006,-0.013,0.036).

[abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a3: coarse h 0.012 plus one body box (0.0058 r0.008) with f2/edges gave 15.5k DOFs, 20.7% field, base 0.233 vs 24.4k at 16.7% (0.226). Own 20.3k recipe scored 0.237 rank 7. Target ~14-15k DOFs; cost dominates.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Diversity experiment: h 0.016, body box 0.0065, only two flank boxes 0.003 (z 0.018-0.034) and f2 0.003, aiming ~13k DOFs.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Error is diffuse in junction band z 0.018-0.036 (hotspots near f16, f19, f20, f10 at x ±0.013-0.020, h 0.004-0.0042, VM err 14-20%); 64 cells outside top 20 hold 44% of energy. Concentrate size 0.003 at x ±0.013-0.02, coarser elsewhere.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Edge refinements 39, 8, 40 at radius 0.005 missed junction hotspots (f16 at h 0.0050) in the h 0.008 recipe. Use a box or radius >=0.008 there.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Uniform h 0.009→0.0055→0.0045 gave compare diffs 26.6% then 16.8% at 2.4x DOFs; spreading 0.0026-0.0035 over three boxes+edges cost 24k DOFs for 16.7%. Concentrate elements.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Do not group-refine the inner bore f23: ~2200 elements at h 0.0038 for little gain. Leave at h ~0.007.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Thin wall with high through-thickness gradient: check thickness in inspect_geometry; keep local size ~thickness/2 at junctions.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Boss shafts and end faces f15/f17 (h 0.0073) carry no hotspots. Do not refine; body box must stop at |x| 0.021.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Setup correct, keep: 3d, order 2, fixed f2, p 4e6 on f23, p 2.1e6 on f16, E 210e9, nu 0.3. Varying net force on curved f16 is facet geometry. Check f2 reaction.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Score=(g/2)^2/(DOFs/6057). g 1.91 at 24k gave 0.226; ~14k at g 1.6 would give ~0.28. Cheaper graded wins; don't add DOFs for a 7.8% compare change.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Control recipe (best): h 0.008 P2; tier1 0.0018, tier2 0.003, ext box 0.0036 r0.003, f7 0.0035 r0.006, upper 0.004 r0.004. 5825 nodes, 8.12% field, 7.77% points, 17.5k DOFs, rank 1. Reuse as base, changing one factor.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Solve plan: s1 P1 variant; s2 P2 fallback (h 0.008, clamp box 0.0016 r0.007, f7 0.0035 r0.006, upper 0.0038 r0.004; 5705 nodes); s3 P2 x0.75 reference (h 0.006); compare(1,3), compare(2,3); rank by e*DOFs, e≈1.27×compare.

[abc_00000065_bc0] P1 prior from a10 (h 0.002, 22.5k DOFs): energy 2.0077e-4 vs ~2.146e-4 fine P2, 6.4% low. Expect P1 at 17k far worse than P2's ~8%. Run once as measurement; submit only if energy within ~0.5% of P2 candidate.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Ext box 0.0036 left f38 hotspot (y~0.020, z~-0.0043) at h 0.00414, 8.8% VM error. Use 0.003 (+500-900 DOFs est). If #6 stays coarse, change only radius to 0.004.

[abc_00000065_bc0] Band box [0.014,-0.026,-0.0081,0.028,0.024,-0.0035] 0.0036 is worth little energy (-0.23%, -7.3% DOFs if dropped) but carries point accuracy: without it points 8.17%. Keep wide y coverage below z -0.0035 at <=0.0036. Two side boxes 0.0038 gave no gain.
[abc_00000065_bc0] Side boxes at 0.0038 under local h 0.0042-0.0045 did nothing (#6 near f4 stayed h 0.0032). A side box must be <=0.6x local h (<=0.0027) or left out.
